articles.summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” “IVT” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) announced, effective immediately, the appointment of Smita N. Shah to the InvenTrust Board of Directors. Ms. Shah currently serves as President and CEO of SPAAN Tech, Inc., a Chicago-based public and private economic development firm, which she founded. Ms. Shah brings considerable business and management experience to the InvenTrust Board as well as a unique insight to governmental civic and environmental programs. Ms. Shah will join the Board as an independent director and a member of the Audit Committee. “Smita’s appointment furthers InvenTrust’s commitment to finding high-caliber professionals across all levels of the Company, while enhancing our governance and management oversight efforts,” said Paula J.
